messages.subject: plot not reactive
parts:
Hi,
I´m new to shiny and tried to build an easy example.
I´ve followed the online tutorials but couldn´t get the plot to react to the radio buttons!
What am I missing here? 

server.R:

library(shiny)

gliom <- read.csv("data/gliom_0801_1346.csv")

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  falist <- list("fa35up"=c("2","3","4","4"), "fa35down"=c("2", "3","3","4"), "fa35asis"=c("2","3","3.5","4"), "fa35out"=c("2", "3", "NA", "4"), "fahighlow"= c("2", "4", "4", "4"))
  output$bubble <- renderPlot({
    
    y <- as.numeric(factor(gliom$Rdx.new, labels=falist[input$kollektiv]))
    x <- as.numeric(factor(gliom$Grade))
    gliom.heat <- as.data.frame(table(x,y, useNA="no"))
    ggplot(gliom.heat, aes(x, y)) + geom_tile(aes(fill =Freq), colour="black") + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high ="steelblue")

  })
  
})

ui.R :

library(shiny)
# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("my dataset"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
    radioButtons("kollektiv", label = h1("Valg"),
                                      choices = list("HGG4" = 1,
                                                      "HGG3" = 2,
                                                      "HGG3.5" = 3,
                                                      "HGGexcluded" = 4,
                                                      "LGGvs.HGG" = 5))),
    mainPanel(plotOutput("bubble")))
  
))

Thanks for your help...

I've modified the code according to your comment:

ui.R

library(shiny)
# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("my dataset"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      radioButtons("kollektiv", label = h1("Valg"),

choices = list("HGG4" = "fa35up",
                                  "HGG3" = "fa35down",
                                  "HGG3.5" = "fa35asis",
                                  "HGGexcluded" = "fa35out",
                                  "LGGvs.HGG" = "fahighlow"))),
    mainPanel(
                textOutput("text"),
                plotOutput("bubble")
            
            )
          )
  
))

server.R:

library(shiny)

#gliom <- read.csv("data/gliom_0801_1346.csv")

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  falist <- list("fa35up"=c("2","3","4","4"), "fa35down"=c("2", "3","3","4"), "fa35asis"=c("2","3","3.5","4"), "fa35out"=c("2", "3", NA, "4"), "fahighlow"= c("2", "4", "4", "4"))
  output$text <- renderText({input$kollektiv})
  output$bubble <- renderPlot({
    factory <- factor(gliom$Rdx.new)
    levels(factory) <- falist[[input$kollektiv]]
    y <- factory
    x <- factor(gliom$Grade)

gliom.heat <- as.data.frame(table(x,y, useNA="no"))
    ggplot(gliom.heat, aes(x, y)) + geom_tile(aes(fill =Freq), colour="black") + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high ="steelblue")
    
  })
  
})

This works. Thanks for your help.
Just one final question.

This line of code caused som trouble for me:

when 

input$kollektiv

represented a numeric value it didn't work. It seemed not to select the right list element.
as a character value/label it selected the right list element and everything worked fine.
What's the reason for this?

Thanks for your help.
